text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The World Bank advises the government not to set a minimum wage for private sector employees in Bahrain, labour and social affairs minister says.
- Study says Bahrain's non-oil economy increases by 5.5 percent annually.
- Gulf Arab states to stage joint military exercises in the next four months.
- India to help Bahrain develop small and medium industries.
- Shares worth more than two million dinars were traded on Wednesday on the Bahrain Stock Exchange.
- Bahrain Stock Exchange's board is restructured. Commerce minister appointed chairman of the board.
